rows.label: Property tax levy cap
rows.value: Annual levy growth limited to 2% or the rate of inflation, whichever is less
rows.note: Applies to local governments and school districts outside the Big Five cities; can be overridden by a 60% vote. Guidance published 2011 (cap later made permanent).

sections.title: New York real estate transfer tax

rows.label: State real estate transfer tax
rows.value: $2 per $500 of consideration (or fraction), when consideration exceeds $500
rows.note: Equivalent to 0.4%. Paid by the seller; if the seller does not pay or is exempt, the buyer must pay.

source.title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)

rows.label: Mansion tax (residences of $1 million or more)
rows.note: Additional 1% of the sale price on residences sold for $1 million or more; paid by the buyer.

source.title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)

rows.label: New York City additional state taxes
rows.value: Additional base tax $1.25 per $500 (residential $3M+, other property $2M+); supplemental tax 0.25% to 2.9% on residential $2M+
rows.note: State taxes on NYC conveyances since July 1, 2019; supplemental tax rates are in Form TP-584-NYC-I. Separate from the City's own transfer tax.

source.title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: Seller pays the base and additional base tax; buyer pays the mansion tax and supplemental tax
rows.note: If the responsible party does not pay or is exempt, the other party must pay.
